integrity.claim_scope: One theorem with two equivalent fixed-sign formulations; no computational evidence is used.
unproved_limits: No complex-scalar analogue is asserted from the same one-ray hypothesis.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is proved only over the real scalar field.
Dimension greater than one is required for the positive-sign formulation.
The claim concerns exact projection identities, not the weaker bad-projection inequality.
Literature searches cannot exclude an equivalent under-indexed reformulation.
title: A one-scale rank-one projection test for the Daugavet property
